text: The transformer-free learned provider remains unqualified. The practical product architecture is now a hybrid design using a conventional quantized host model with an Engram retrieval sidecar and controlled baseline comparisons.
prompt_text: Practical architecture: hybrid host plus Engram retrieval sidecar.

text: The deployment policy requires CPU inference without GPU dependence. CUDA acceleration is allowed for training and distillation, but deployed generation and the retrieval sidecar must be able to run on CPU.
prompt_text: Inference runs on CPU; CUDA is allowed only for training or distillation.

text: In hybrid mode the conventional host language model owns tokenization, hidden states, attention, MLP evaluation, logits, and token generation. Engram retrieves bounded provenance-tagged memory and supplies it as reference context.
prompt_text: The host model generates tokens; Engram supplies bounded retrieved context.

text: Project documentation and measured reports are committed to the development-semantic-gate branch and pushed to the GitHub repository after verification.
prompt_text: Verified reports are committed and pushed to the development branch.
